Hi Anna / Team,

Thanks for the log. Quick triage notes from my side after a quick pass:
- 502 "upstream internal server error" often indicates either a malformed request payload (we have strict schema validation for structured calls) or an internal modelworker crash triggered by an input pattern (rare).
- Max request size: currently ~1.5 MB for the body on hosted endpoints. If you are sending large context + reranker data, that could push us over the limit.
- Reranker: it's invoked as a separate internal step and we currently stream the ranking request internally — if the reranker config references an unsupported model or an empty candidate list it can surface as a 5xx.

Can you please share the exact JSON you used for the failing call (headers + body)? If you prefer, run the following curl from staging and attach the output: 

curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <TEST_JWT>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d @payload.json 

I attached a short server-side trace capture template (sdk-trace-20270407.txt) — fill in the request_id and paste it back and that will help us tie the logs together.

Temporary mitigation while we debug:
- Remove the "reranker" object and fall back to client-side reranking, or
- Increase client timeout to 30s (some reranker runs can be slower for large candidate sets).

I'll look at the trace when you send it and we can join the screen share if needed.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee

soojin_lee@redwood.com

- lighthouse-malpayload.json (full request body)
- lighthouse-sdk-error.log (full log)

{
  "model": "redwood-instruct-v2",
  "input": "summarize: ...",
  "structured_output": {"schema": {...}},
  "reranker": {"method":"client_side","candidate_set":[...]} 
}

If removing the candidate_set is a recommended short term approach then we can do that today. Happy to jump on the 10am PT slot.

Anna
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@lighthouse.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lighthouse post-demo: integration recap + next steps

Anna — thanks for the repro payload and trace. Short mitigation playbook from the field engineering side: 

1) Immediate (try now)
- Remove "reranker.candidate_set" and keep a single candidate or do client-side reranking. This should avoid the internal ranking path.
- Set client timeout to 30s and retry once on 502 with exponential backoff (0.5s -> 2s).

2) Short-term (we will do this)
- Engineering (Soojin) to add server-side guard for empty/invalid candidate lists and return 400 instead of 5xx.
- Add a clearer error message indicating reranker config issues.

3) Follow-up
- If you want us to reproduce live, we can join the 10:00 AM PT debug and run the payload with debug traces on.

I also pushed a quick internal note to the deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/LHT-3742

If that looks good I’ll mark the action item for Redwood engineering to create the guard and we’ll follow up with a patch ETA.

—Priyom
